function.name: geocode_address

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time traffic data. However, I can give you a general overview of typical traffic patterns in New York City:

| Time of Day | Typical Traffic Conditions | Notes |
|-------------|----------------------------|-------|
| **Morning Rush (7 – 9 am)** | Heavy congestion on major arteries (e.g., I‑95, I‑87, I‑278, I‑495). | Commute traffic from suburbs into Manhattan. |
| **Midday (10 am – 2 pm)** | Moderate traffic; peaks around 12 pm on Broadway and 5th Avenue. | Lunch hour traffic on commercial streets. |
| **Afternoon Rush (3 – 5 pm)** | Heavy congestion again, especially on I‑95, I‑87, and I‑278. | Commute traffic from Manhattan to suburbs. |
| **Evening (6 – 9 pm)** | Moderate to heavy traffic on major routes; lighter on local streets. | Evening commute and nightlife traffic. |
| **Night (10 pm – 6 am)** | Light traffic overall, but occasional congestion on major bridges and tunnels. | Nighttime traffic is usually lighter. |

If you need up‑to‑date traffic information, you can check services like Google Maps, Waze, or the NYC Department of Transportation’s traffic website. Let me know if you’d like help navigating to those resources!
